description.la: Expositio in principium Genesis usque ad natiuitatem Isaac et eiectionem Ismahelis, quattuor libris, ad Accam episcopum Hagustaldensem.
description.en-US: Bede's commentary on Genesis from the creation to the birth of Isaac and the expulsion of Ishmael, in four books dedicated to Bishop Acca of Hexham: the first of his biblical commentaries, patristic in method (Augustine, Basil, Ambrose, Jerome) and allegorical in aim. Latin text of Migne (PL 91-93); no public-domain English translation is known.
description.pt-BR: O comentário de Beda ao Gênesis, da criação ao nascimento de Isaac e à expulsão de Ismael, em quatro livros dedicados ao bispo Acca de Hexham: o primeiro dos seus comentários bíblicos, patrístico no método e alegórico no propósito.

sources.edition: Hexaemeron Beda on Latin Wikisource, from the Corpus Corporum TEI of Migne's Patrologia Latina.
sources.description: Wikitext removed; inline PL column numbers dropped; one file per book (or per part), chapter divisions kept as headings with their rubrics.
sources.tierEvidence: Eighth-century text in Migne's reprint of Giles: public domain.
